Q1_secondary.task_end_2alphaW_note: unit_median_2alpha_sd = per-run median over units of 2*alpha_j*sd_j(z) (column two_alpha_sd_med; sd from the 1200-image end-of-task evaluation), then median over seeds.  product_2_alphamed_zsdmed = 2 * median_j(alpha) * median_j(sd), median over seeds.  stored_two_alpha_W_med_from_V uses sqrt(EMA V), not V_max, so in the grow arm it is not the alpha-times-width of the trained net (shown for reference).
Q1_secondary.runaway_definition: (seed, task t) with switch_ce(t) > 100 and zsd_f2 at the end of task t-1 (the network that met the new labels) > 24; alt: zsd_f2 at the end of task t
